versions.changelog:
- Initial public release connecting 568 Chinese classic lianhuanhua (picture-story books) to chat.
- Supports book search, tag browsing, rankings, and recommendations.
- Provides page-by-page viewing, narration, and immersive AI role-play with book characters.
- Integrated full purchase, VIP, points, and unlocking/payment flows.
- Designed for seamless access without user-side MCP configuration.
